note: Backfill of W/E/R after earlier truncation; Q preserved from Cowork M32 batch. W (Blood Hunt) deals no direct damage: it grants bonus attack speed 70/80/90/100/110% (increased 140/160/180/200/220%) and movement speed vs low-health enemies. E (Primal Howl) deals no damage: 35/40/45/50/55% damage reduction plus fear/slow CC. R heals Warwick for 100% of post-mitigation damage dealt to the target during the ability (heal, not damage, so no fact recorded). P (Eternal Hunger) on-hit damage was not part of this backfill's fetches.
